title: Quarterly revenue pivot
statementMd:
Revenue of non-cancelled orders per quarter of 2024 as columns `q1` and `q2` (Jan-Mar, Apr-Jun), rounded to 2 decimals, in one row.

Expected columns: `q1`, `q2`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Conditional aggregation: `SUM(CASE WHEN ... THEN value END)`.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date < '2024-04-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price END), 2) AS q1, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-04-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price END), 2) AS q2 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled';
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
